basic_info.description: Gorgeous Modern Home with Chic Design and Twin Peaks Views. This beautifully renovated two-story home offers the perfect blend of style, comfort, and convenience. Featuring an open floor plan with modern amenities, this 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom residence boasts spacious living and dining areas, a family room with a wet bar lounge, and a dedicated office space overlooking a large backyard. The backyard garden is thoughtfully designed with multiple entertainment areas, perfect for hosting or relaxing. Enjoy beautiful Twin Peaks views from this thoughtfully designed property, complete with luxurious finishes and an inviting ambiance. Located just a short walk from McLaren Park, you'll have easy access to scenic daily walks and outdoor activities. With close proximity to BART, public transit, and freeways, commuting is a breeze.    This home is the perfect retreat for modern living, offering both tranquility and convenience. Don't miss this opportunity to make it yours!
